opportunities.name: Short Fuse siege cycle
opportunities.objective: Reduce passive cooldown through casts and deliver repeated structure attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: Short Fuse's AP magic packet is multiplied against structures and casts reduce its cooldown. Lich Bane tests spell-followed structure attacks; Nashor supports actual attack cadence while Hullbreaker rewards fifth attacks and nearby siege minions. W destroys towers only after the specified health threshold.
opportunities.requiredState: A reachable tower, tracked passive/Spellblade cooldowns, wave present and W threshold recorded.
opportunities.failure: Defenders force retreat before attacks and delaying mana or penetration loses wave control.
opportunities.test: Log tower damage after spaced casts and every fifth attack, separating Short Fuse, Lich Bane and Hullbreaker.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Short Fuse's structure multiplier is not automatically applied to item damage.

opportunities.name: Satchel mine path
opportunities.objective: Force a mine crossing before landing the center of R.
opportunities.mechanic: W knocks enemies away and E mines slow for a finite ten-second area. Directed W can move a target across E and delay escape from R's center, which deals more than its edge. Bloodletter tests magic damage ramp, Cosmic supports repositioning and Liandry asks for retained damage contact.
opportunities.requiredState: Mines placed on the expected knockback path and R center aimed at the resulting position.
opportunities.failure: Incorrect W direction clears the target away from mines or R delay permits escape.
opportunities.test: Count mine damage packets and center/edge R hits with W knockback through versus away from E.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: E primary description states successive mine detonations on one target deal reduced damage, so do not sum full packets.

ruledOut.reason: W's destruction requires the tower to be below its rank-dependent health percentage.

unknowns: Passive base cooldown token, mine repeat-hit attenuation and structure item inheritance need measured checks.

builds.name: Short Fuse siege cycle
builds.summary: Reduce passive cooldown through casts and deliver repeated structure attacks.
builds.goal: Reduce passive cooldown through casts and deliver repeated structure attacks.
builds.hypothesis: Short Fuse's AP magic packet is multiplied against structures and casts reduce its cooldown. Lich Bane tests spell-followed structure attacks; Nashor supports actual attack cadence while Hullbreaker rewards fifth attacks and nearby siege minions. W destroys towers only after the specified health threshold.
testPlan: Required state: A reachable tower, tracked passive/Spellblade cooldowns, wave present and W threshold recorded.
Log tower damage after spaced casts and every fifth attack, separating Short Fuse, Lich Bane and Hullbreaker.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Defenders force retreat before attacks and delaying mana or penetration loses wave control.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Short Fuse's structure multiplier is not automatically applied to item damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Hullbreaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
